subject: fix(xpu): strip graph padding from GDN index tensors

companion.scope: Verdict applies to the exact v0.33 dependency. Newer v0.1.17 is under separate investigation and is not assumed selected.

requirement.failure: The native SYCL GDN interface requires exact live request counts in its state-index, query-start and accepted-token metadata. Graph staging can retain padded request rows while separately reporting live counts, causing native TORCH_CHECK failures.
requirement.behavior: Slice only dimension 0 of five metadata tensors immediately before the native call. Preserve all speculative rollback columns, the original data tensors, num_actual_tokens, underlying storage, and optional None values.
requirement.workload: Qwen GDN on Intel XPU, including padded decode/speculative batches. The deployed eager V2/DFlash2 profile need not trigger every padding case, but alternate graph configurations remain supported.
requirement.final_old_stack: Subsequent efddf8010f adds split_mixed_non_spec calculation and flag after this normalization; it does not supersede the trim. The remaining three local commits do not remove or replace these five slices.
requirement.benefit: Correctness/metadata compatibility safeguard; no measured standalone performance improvement claimed.

upstream_coverage.evidence: git diff --exit-code OLD_BASE TARGET -- vllm/_xpu_ops.py exits 0. The whole file is unchanged between the frozen upstream bases; the adapter still forwards the metadata tensors without live-row trimming.

batch_size remains m.num_reqs; staged spec state/accepted metadata use [:batch_size], query starts use [:batch_size+1], and trailing slots are filled after num_spec_decodes. Ordinary decode staging similarly uses batch_size rather than num_decodes.
upstream_coverage.coverage: none; the producer still permits request padding

upstream_coverage.subject: [XPU] [Feature] Adding triton/sycl GDN toggle (#56835)
upstream_coverage.evidence: Upstream can now choose a Triton whole-layer path. On XPU auto and sycl still resolve to sycl when torch.ops._xpu_C.gdn_attention exists, and the SYCL forward branch still calls torch.ops.vllm.gdn_attention_core_xpu. Changing all supported configurations to Triton would be a separate behavior/performance change; availability of that alternate implementation does not fix the active native contract.
upstream_coverage.coverage: alternate backend bypasses this boundary, but default SYCL requirement remains

upstream_coverage.subject: [Perf][GDN] Internal prefill checkpoints for the FlashInfer GDN prefill backend (#60050)
upstream_coverage.evidence: Adds FlashInfer-specific prefill checkpoint planning and a metadata field. Does not change SYCL request-row normalization.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Perf][GDN] Skip FLA chunk metadata when FlashInfer GDN prefill is active (#61569)
upstream_coverage.evidence: Skips unused FLA chunk metadata only for FlashInfer; does not alter native SYCL index tensors or counts.

Native causal_conv1d_spec checks query starts == num_spec_decodes+1, state rows == num_spec_decodes, accepted rows == num_spec_decodes. Non-spec path checks query starts == num_prefills+num_decodes+1 and state rows == num_prefills+num_decodes. Companion fork changes add mixed dispatch and disable tiled prefill but do not relax or replace those checks.
